caption: The video showcases a Canon EF 70-200mm zoom lens standing upright, front element facing up on a circular reflective platform, against a warm amber sunburst background with diagonal light streaks. The lens turns slowly about its vertical axis while the camera framing stays fixed, so the markings on the front ring—the brand name, green index arc, aperture text, and "LENS MADE IN JAPAN" legend—gradually slide around the circumference. The silver "ULTRASONIC" band and the side "LOCK" switch panel also shift slightly in apparent orientation, with the panel keeping its upright label toward the viewer. A mirror reflection of the ribbed barrel below tracks the body, while the platform edge and glowing backdrop remain stationary. No operator or drive mechanism is visible.
